sentences.japanese: 暗い所が怖いっていうのを乗り越える必要がありますね。
sentences.english: You must conquer your fear of the dark.

sentences.japanese: 君がここにいてくれるなら、なにも怖いものなし。鬼に金棒だよ。
sentences.english: With you here beside me I'm not afraid of anything. You're my fortress.

sentences.japanese: 何も怖がることはない。
sentences.english: There's nothing to be afraid of.

sentences.japanese: 何も怖いことなんかないんだよ。
sentences.english: There's nothing to be afraid of.
